svg.text: D24 · F3 PREPARE THE RIVAL (A1 SUCCESS, REGENERATE AND UNDO)
Briefing: another strategy, with undo (user control)

text.tspan: F3 Prepare the rival (A1 success, regenerate and undo)
User control: the player asked for another strategy
(Counter-gusts became Gentle breeze) and can undo. Mock AI
The new strategy, and who chose it: "Strategy chosen by" the
Undo: back to the strategy the player had before. Pressing
The start button repeats the chosen strategy, so the player
Edit is not offered by design: the strategy is the
opponent's move. Changing difficulty asks for a new one.
